name: Sakura, Moyu. -as the Night's, Reincarnation-
original_name: さくら、もゆ。-as the Night's, Reincarnation-
source:
This is a story of [i]magical girls[/i].

Once upon a time,
a handful of [i]magical girls[/i] are said to have saved the world.

In a tale that's all too common, war was waged.
Blood and tears were shed,
and all prayed for salvation.

And yet, when all was said and done—
when blood and tears were wrung dry,
and all prayers gone—
not a soul offered them any thanks.
None even knew it had happened at all.

Nonetheless, the [i]war[/i] was won.

These girls made their tale's end a happy one.

Ten years later. Present day...

Spring.

A season of meetings and partings, awash with blossom's vows.

The girls who once saved the world now lead peaceful lives,
having forgotten how to use [i]magic[/i] entirely.

One day,
beneath the petals scattering in the sky.

"[b]Please...[/b]"

A boy named Taiga finds himself reunited with a girl,
and face to face with spring once more.

"[b]Turn me back into a magical girl.[/b]"

This is a story of [i]magical girls[/i].

Nay, it is a tale of seeking happiness; of prayer.

A story of something to live for.

A story of a trigger pulled,
so that you never need feel sorrow again,
on the night the blossoms bloom.

If it's to save you and you alone...

I'll scatter and fall as many times as it takes...

[From official [url=https://kagamied.com/sakumoyu-en/]english website[/url]]
translation:
这是[i]魔法少女[/i]的故事。

曾几何时，
据说有少数[i]魔法少女[/i]拯救了世界。

在一个太常见的故事中，战争爆发了。
流下了血和泪，
所有人都祈求救赎。

然而，当一切都说了、做了之后——
当血和泪水被拧干时，
所有的祈祷都消失了——
没有人对他们表示任何感谢。
甚至没有人知道这件事已经发生了。

尽管如此，[i]战争[/i]还是胜利了。

这些女孩使她们的故事有了圆满的结局。

十年后。如今…

春天。

相逢与离别的季节，充满了花开的誓言。

曾经拯救世界的女孩们现在过着平静的生活，
完全忘记了如何使用[i]magic[/i]。

有一天，
天空中散落的花瓣之下。

“[b]请…[/b]”

一个名叫大河的男孩发现自己与一个女孩重逢，
再次与春天面对面。

“[b]让我变回魔法少女。[/b]”

这是[i]魔法少女[/i]的故事。

不，这是一个寻求幸福的故事；的祈祷。

一个关于为之而活的故事。

扣动扳机的故事，
让你不再感到悲伤
花开的夜晚。

如果是为了拯救你和你一个人……

我会无数次地四散坠落……

[来自官方[url=https://kagamied.com/sakumoyu-en/]英文网站[/url]]
